title: Unpointed etale algebra model at a prime
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and p a prime of Spec R [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Let alpha : R_p to B be a ring map whose map of spectra is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. There exist a commutative ring C, maps a : R to C and i : C to B, and a submonoid M of C, such that Spec(a) is etale, a followed by i equals the composite R to R_p to B, and B is an M-localization of C for the algebra structure induced by i. No field-valued pointing is part of the conclusion.

source.place: Tags 01ZM, 07RP, 01Z6, 00CR and 00CP; unpointed affine descent and localization identification in the parent proof

proof.text: Use CommRingCat.isColimitAwayProdCocone (00CR) to identify the filtered colimit A of principal localizations R[1/product(s)] with R_p. Transport alpha along the colimit comparison. Apply exists_etale_algebra_of_filteredColimit (00U2 (9)) to obtain a principal stage S, an etale S-algebra C, and an A-algebra isomorphism e : B to A tensor_S C.

Set a to the composite R to S to C. Algebra.Etale.of_isLocalizationAway and composition of etale spectrum maps show that a is etale (00U2 (1), (2)). Set i to tensor includeRight followed by e inverse. Tensor balancing and e inverse.commutes show g followed by i equals the stage coprojection followed by the structure map. The colimit comparison identity and ofHom_algebraMap_comp_awayProdCocone_ι_app give the required R structure equation.

Transport IsLocalization at the complement of p from R_p to A using IsLocalization.isLocalization_iff_of_ringEquiv. The colimit comparison identity, evaluated on algebraMap R S x, proves the scalar-tower equation for R, S, A.

The powers of product(s) lie in the complement of p by Submonoid.powers_le and Submonoid.prod_mem. Apply IsLocalization.isLocalization_of_submonoid_le to make A a localization of S at N, the image of this complement.

Let M be the image of N in C. IsLocalization.tensorRight makes A tensor_S C an M-localization of C. IsLocalization.isLocalization_iff_of_ringEquiv along e inverse gives IsLocalization M B with algebra map e inverse composed with tensor includeRight, exactly the map i constructed above.

proof_origin.place: Tag 00U2, proof of (10) from (9), (1), (2); Tags 00CR and 00CP; the ring-level argument replaces the earlier scheme-level descent route

A finitely presented etale algebra over a localization at a prime is the localization of an etale algebra over the original ring
mathlib_searches.results: Algebra.exists_etale_of_isEtaleAt, Algebra.Etale.of_isLocalizationAway and localization-span results. None constructs a model for a given R_p-algebra.
mathlib_searches.verdict: No direct match; local etale-locus lemmas do not provide this model.

mathlib_searches.query: etale.*[Dd]escent|exists.*etale.*[Ll]ocalization; rg Scheme.exists_isAffine_of_isLimit; rg awayProdDiagram and isColimitAwayProdCocone
mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib Etale.Descent only supplies faithfully flat descent. Sheaf.Paper.EtaleFiniteDataDescent is scheme-level descent; Mathlib Scheme.exists_isAffine_of_isLimit supplies affine-stage descent; WeilConjectures.Mathlib.Algebra.Category.Ring.FilteredColimits supplies the principal-localization colimit. No theorem with the unpointed ring-model conclusion was found.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Generic ingredients exist but assembling the ring-model descent is the remaining obligation.

lean.statement:
theorem primeLocalization_etale_algebra_model
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (p : Spec R) (B : CommRingCat.{u})
    (α : CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) ⟶ B)
    (hα : Etale (Spec.map α)) :
    ∃ (C : CommRingCat.{u}) (a : R ⟶ C) (i : C ⟶ B),
      Etale (Spec.map a) ∧
      a ≫ i = CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) ≫ α ∧
      ∃ M : Submonoid C, (letI := i.hom.toAlgebra; IsLocalization M B)
